h: Iyabo Ojo and Paulo's sweet exchange gets fans talking amid rumours of a new man
p: A friendly public exchange between Nollywood actress Iyabo Ojo and Paulo has caught the attention of fans, who are linking it to rumours that she has a new partner. Neither has confirmed any relationship.
more: Fans have flooded the comment section with guesses.
Iyabo Ojo has not addressed the rumours directly.
